completion_criteria: Scientific consistency is never operational authorization: SCIENTIFIC_INTEGRITY_CONSISTENT must not itself authorize strategy, paper, live, capital or execution action.

Define a verifier-controlled authority trust policy: canonical authority identity, controller authentication/allowed source, generation/state resolution, limitations and adapter assumptions. Reject self-issued or unmapped commitments. Local self-digests prove content integrity only.

Machine-enforce commitment-ID uniqueness, replay/duplicate consumption, stale generation and already-consumed evidence using durable replay state appropriate to M0. State explicitly what is synthetic versus durable and fail closed when unavailable.

Implement event-derived lifecycle transitions with exact evidence and independent-review requirements. Reject skipped, terminal-resurrected, conflicting or unsupported IDEA/BACKTESTED/REJECTED-to-live paths and paper states without prerequisites.
Implement distinct accountable review/approval records and trust-policy checks. Role strings, Git authorship and self-authored artifacts cannot establish human or cryptographic independence.

Implement typed STOP scope, precedence, acknowledgement, dependency propagation, quarantine, remediation evidence and clearing authority. OPEN, stale, missing or unreadable applicable STOP state blocks lifecycle/operational actions. STOP clearance remains unavailable until independent process evidence exists.

Implement M0 integer-minor-unit paper/live-separated ledger and reconciliation invariants: no money creation or negative balances; deployable cannot exceed reconciled available funds; reservations/liabilities settle idempotently; duplicate settlement rejects; stale/corrupt snapshots deny. Preserve ledger history with compensating corrections.

Represent position, daily, strategy, source, event and correlated exposure. Model overlapping source/market/strategy/event dependencies so duplicate opinions cannot count as diversification. Empirical thresholds remain configurable/unresolved and must deny live exposure while zero deployable capital persists.

Implement latched kill-switch state with global precedence, health/data/price/bankroll/reconciliation/execution/drawdown/degradation/limit/STOP triggers, execution-time recheck, durable evidence and authority-bound reset. Test pending authorization races and exposure-neutral settlement behavior.

Keep paper and live ledgers, eligibility and approvals distinct. A paper or live approval cannot make an individual execution safe; every future execution decision must recheck current controls. No sportsbook, prediction market, deposit, account authentication or wagering integration.

Preserve total conceptual bankroll 5000 minor units, deployable/reserved zero, live LOCKED and kill ENGAGED. M0 completion never unlocks capital; a later independently reviewed strategy-specific live-capital gate is required.

Publish tests, completion inventory/hashes, exact SHAs, interfaces/migrations, full-suite dispositions, authority assumptions and finding-to-test mapping. Obtain independent Skeptic Risk review and a new Director gate before any STOP-clearance consideration.
